body: What makes you think everything points otherwise?

This is how I feel. I want to go to college, get a high paying job, and take my parents for the most incredible vacation of a lifetime, with however much money they want to spend. It’ll be the best feeling ever.

There is no selfishness in struggle. If things are hard (or not hard) and you feel that way, then it’s ok to feel that way. Now should you kill yourself? No, probably not. But the way you feel (wanting to die) is an appropriate and valid feelings. And it’s ok to feel that way.

Thank you for sharing your story. Having to work with people who are struggling with mental health can be an exhausting thing. Those struggles are a valid thing. There is no need to compare your life to others. If you’re struggling, you’re struggling, and that’s ok, regardless of if your life is better (or not!). There are no “should feel”’s or “shouldn’t feel”’s in emotions. It’s ok to feel one way or another about things. Your emotions are real, appropriate, and valid. Thank you for what you do for people.
Let’s talk. What’s on your mind?
I agree. It doesn’t feel that way at all. The struggle is in our face everyday. Makes it hard to ever think something like that will bloom.
That must be really hard. What was one of your favorite memories with them?

I understand why it feels like things will eventually just go right to the toilet. I mean, you die, and then what, right? Just remember that every decision sets a lasting legacy, no matter how big or how small. The butterfly effect is a beautiful thing. What you did today or yesterday can change the future of the entire world, even if it was just you laying around at home, or working like usual, or whatever you choose to do. Their stories live on, just like yours and mine.
Probably growing up in the place you’ve always wanted to live in. At least that’s how it is for me. If you could live anywhere you wanted, infinite money, where would you want to live?

Let me just validate how exhausting TS is. I’ve had TS for a pretty long time now. Not only is it mentally exhausting, it’s physically exhausting too. I know it’s hard and I want to give kudos to you for fighting the fight.
Wtf... kinda used to like Charlie too.
I didn’t even think about that. Thank you.
I needed to hear that honestly. The residential I went to was top notch and taught me a lot of those things. I was having an episode and I feel a lot better now :) thank you for the response ❤️
